seo_title: Breakfast all day in Astana — Frnds on the left bank
seo_description: Scrambled eggs, shakshuka, syrniki, waffles and porridge — 09:00 to 23:00, every day. Frnds, Astana, 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov St, near Khan Shatyr.
intro: Slept in? No harm done. We cook breakfast from 09:00 to 23:00 — comfort here doesn't run on a schedule.
body:
We open at nine in the morning and close at eleven at night, and the kitchen cooks breakfast that whole time. Not until noon. No switching over to the main menu at 12:00. All day, every day, no exceptions. The kitchen never takes a break, so come by whenever you like between open and close. It's one of the reasons people keep coming back: someone walks in at eight in the evening, orders scrambled eggs with toast, and finally exhales. Nobody tells them they're too late.

What's on: scrambled eggs, shakshuka, omelettes, syrniki with sour cream, waffles, porridge. We make our pizza dough ourselves, and that pays off at breakfast too — if one person at the table wants eggs and another wants pizza, there's nothing to argue about. To go with it, specialty coffee, our own teas, lemonades, smoothies and milkshakes. The bar list is long, and choosing takes a while in the best way.

All sorts of people come in. The ones who slept in and aren't ready to admit the morning is over. The ones working from a café with a laptop, stretching one cup over three hours — that's fine, we won't rush you. The ones who want syrniki in the evening instead of dinner, which is honestly the smartest call on the menu. We're easy to find: 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street, left bank, Esil district, a short walk from Khan Shatyr and Sarayshyk Street. There's room in the dining room, and there's pickup: message us ahead and your order will be ready when you get here.
cta_text: Message us on WhatsApp +7 707 480 92 15 — we'll hold a table or pack up breakfast for pickup.
